stage10_evaluation_period.rationale: Models were frozen strictly on pre-2026 data and features evaluated point-in-time, but execution occurred in batch replay on 2026-10-16.

historical_gap_period.rationale: No prospective collector was installed or running during this interval. Retrospective backfill cannot be claimed as prospective.

genuine_prospective_frontier.rationale: First verifiable operational timestamp of the forward collector on streaming live market data.

epistemic_audit_classification.hash_chain_limitation_statement: Local SHA-256 recursive hash chaining guarantees internal tamper-evidence from the moment the ledger is generated. It does NOT independently prove historical existence prior to generation without external RFC 3161 TSA or public blockchain commitment.

governance.production_task: Annualized Forward 7-Day Realized Variance (rv7d_var_ann) & C2 Conformal Risk Envelope

HAR-RS-DOW-v1.0.calibration_method: Strictly Causal C2 Conformal Prediction (alpha=0.10, nominal 90%)

causal_execution_rules.candle_closure_rule: Forecasts are emitted ONLY after the hourly candle closes and finalizes.
causal_execution_rules.issuance_logging_rule: Forecast event is appended to ledger BEFORE the future outcome window elapses.
causal_execution_rules.delayed_resolution_rule: Resolutions occur strictly after origin + horizon_hours has fully closed.
causal_execution_rules.causal_conformal_calibration_rule: Scale estimates and calibration pools for conformal intervals use ONLY outcomes resolved strictly before forecast origin.

statistical_acceptance_criteria.seventy_percent_claim_hurdle: 95% stationary block bootstrap lower confidence bound must be >= 70.0% on forward data.
statistical_acceptance_criteria.current_status: UNSUBSTANTIATED (Upper bound on holdout is 53.36%, 16.64% below 70.0%)
